purpose: Logo ideation for Finfolk: freedivers and freediving training

directions.name: Fin ligature
directions.note: A refined fashion mark, with long-fin shapes hidden inside the letterforms.
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original logo ideation presentation tile for Finfolk, a community and logbook strictly for freedivers and freediving training. The existing logo in input image 1 is a brand reference only; create a new direction, not a redraw. The overall taste is whimsical high fashion, natural-history strangeness and clever Escher-like geometry. Be disciplined: a strong, beautifully balanced flat logo that can become a practical vector mark later, with no intricate illustration. The main artwork uses midnight navy #172440 on warm ivory #eee5d3. The exact wordmark text is lowercase "finfolk", spelled f-i-n-f-o-l-k, with no slogan or other text. Square 1024x1024 presentation, generous empty ivory margin, the large standalone symbol centered in the upper half and its readable finfolk wordmark centered below. At the bottom, a restrained row of three small applications of the SAME proposed mark: small navy mark on ivory, ivory mark on a solid navy square, and cobalt mark on a solid acid-yellow square with one hot-pink accent. No mockup photography, no fabric, no shadows, no 3D, no gradients, no watermark, no technical annotations or labels, no text other than finfolk. The mark must work in a single flat colour, and its miniature versions must match the main symbol. No scuba tanks, spears, anchors, nautical stripes, generic stock wave logos or copying any fashion brand logo.
Specific direction: An elegant interlocking lowercase ff monogram made from two long freediving fin blades. Controlled curved negative space and a slight Escher-like shared edge. Both letters remain legible; simple enough for an app icon. Pair with a distinctive high-contrast lowercase serif wordmark with a subtle f-to-i ligature.
directions.refine: Simplify the blade seams for the smallest app-icon sizes.

directions.name: Odd little club
directions.note: An expressive wordmark that gives the hyper collection its own confidence.
directions.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a square 1024x1024 original typographic logo exploration board for the freediving brand "finfolk". This direction is strictly TYPOGRAPHY ONLY: the wordmark is the entire hero, with NO animal symbol, NO human figure, NO mermaid, NO circular icon, NO fins drawing above it. Design the exact lowercase word "finfolk" as bespoke sculptural chunky letterforms: confident fashion resort-club energy, playful bends, one unusually tall f, elegant fin-shaped cuts in the f stems. Very readable, precisely spelled f-i-n-f-o-l-k. Sophisticated but cheeky, not a children's bubble font, not a stock rounded font. Main wordmark very large, midnight navy #172440 on warm ivory #eee5d3, across the central upper half with a lot of negative space. Below the main wordmark place a compact typographic "ff" stamp made from the exact same letterforms. Bottom row: repeat the SAME finfolk wordmark three times, small navy on ivory, ivory on a navy square, and cobalt blue on an acid-yellow square with one hot-pink f. Only the texts "finfolk" and "ff" are allowed. Flat precise logo graphics; no gradients, 3D, paper texture, mockups, shadows, border or extra copy.
directions.refine: Simplify the fin-shaped cuts when the wordmark is very small.
